title: features/link/clock.feature and the cucumber runner crates/apricity-engine/tests/clock.rs (red first)
description:
## Intent
Write the four M1 stories as `features/link/clock.feature` and a cucumber-rs runner, and watch them fail for the right reason.

Stories: apricitus-a65057, apricitus-91ed40, apricitus-865b9a, apricitus-ba8ee6.

## Steps
1. `features/link/clock.feature`: the Gherkin from the stories, verbatim.
2. `crates/apricity-engine/tests/clock.rs`: cucumber runner (dev-dependency `cucumber = "0.21"`, as `apricity-sources` uses), `harness = false` in `Cargo.toml`. Drives the `Mixer` block by block from a scripted clock, captures output, uses the click finder.
3. Every scenario fails because following doesn't exist, not because of a step error.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-engine --test clock` shows every scenario failing on its Then step (paste the summary). Later tasks turn it green.

Commit: folded into the implementing tasks' commits, or `test(<this task id>)`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
